doctrine.notes: This registry describes evidence maturity of portfolio assets. Gauntlet opportunity status, route allocation, execution state, and G0-G6 gates remain separate authorities. A route may use multiple assets with different maturity; the portfolio-allocation authority chooses lead versus support without fabricating a single maturity score.
